zh: 創世與應許：神是萬物的源頭，即便在軟弱中，祂的立約依然堅定。
救贖與聖潔：呼召百姓從奴役進入自由，建立與神相交的祭司國度。
曠野的供應：在試煉與流離中，學習單單仰望那從天而降的生命之糧。
律法與愛：神的話語是腳前的燈，帶領百姓進入應許的豐盛之地。
爭戰與得勝：靠著神的信心得地為業，見證祂在歷史中的奇妙作為。
王權與渴望：在人的失敗中，我們更深切盼望那永恆公義的大衛後裔。
智慧與敬畏：心靈的更新始於對神的尊崇，這才是一切知識的開端。
審判與慈愛：先知的吶喊提醒我們回轉，因為神的憐憫勝過審判。
歸回與重建：在廢墟中重新點燃希望，神正在恢復祂所應許的事工。
道成肉身：神與我們同在，將永恆的救贖帶進短暫的人間歷史。
使命與擴展：聖靈的能力超越邊界，將福音從耶路撒冷傳遍萬邦。
榮耀的盼望：新天新地的預覽，我們等待那終極的團圓與更新。
en: Creation & Promise: God is the source of all; His covenant remains firm even in our weakness.
Redemption & Holiness: Calling people from slavery into freedom, building a priestly kingdom.
Provision in Wilderness: In trials and wandering, learn to look up to the Bread of Life from heaven.
Law & Love: God's word is a lamp to our feet, leading us into the abundance of promise.
Battle & Victory: Take the land by faith, witnessing His wonderful deeds in history.
Kingship & Longing: In human failure, we long more deeply for the eternal Son of David.
Wisdom & Fear: Renewal starts with honoring God, which is the beginning of all knowledge.
Judgment & Mercy: The prophet's cry calls us back, for God's mercy triumphs over judgment.
Return & Rebuilding: Rekindling hope in ruins; God is restoring His promised work.
Incarnation: God is with us, bringing eternal redemption into transient human history.
Mission & Expansion: The Holy Spirit's power transcends borders, spreading the Gospel to all nations.
Glorious Hope: A preview of the new heaven and earth, waiting for the ultimate renewal.

zh: 太棒了！您完成了本月所有的讀經目標！
感謝神！您忠心地完成了這個月的靈修旅程。
做得好！這份堅持將成為您屬靈生命的養分。
完成計畫！願神的話語常存在您心中。
您真的做到了，本月全勤完成！繼續保持！
生命被神的話語充滿，恭喜您完成本月進度。
您的毅力讓人敬佩，願您在恩典中繼續成長。
完成本月讀經，您是主所喜悅的小精兵！
願這個月的每個文字，都化作您生命中的力量。
恭喜！您成功追上了所有的聖經話語。
en: Amazing! You've completed all reading goals for this month!
Praise God! You've faithfully finished this month's spiritual journey.
Well done! This persistence will nourish your spiritual life.
Mission accomplished! May God's Word dwell in you richly.
You did it! 100% completion this month. Keep it up!
Life filled with God's Word! Congratulations on finishing.
Your perseverance is inspiring; keep growing in grace.
Month complete! You are a faithful soldier of the Lord!
May every word from this month turn into strength for your life.
Congrats! You've successfully caught up with all the scriptures.

zh: 別灰心，每一次閱讀都是與神的親近。
今天就開始一點點，進度一定能慢慢補上。
讀經不是比賽，而是與主同行的過程，加油！
還有一些章節沒讀完，我們一起努力補上吧。
沒關係，神在等著您隨時翻開聖經與祂說話。
只要開始，永遠不嫌晚！今天就讀一行也好。
願聖靈催促您的心，重新拾起這份屬靈的閱讀習慣。
雖然忙碌，但別忘了給靈糧留出一點時間。
目前的進度只是休息站，讓我們整理心情繼續出發。
加油！只要持續努力，您一定能完成目標的。
en: Don't lose heart; every bit of reading is closeness with God.
Start a little today, and you'll catch up step by step.
Bible reading isn't a race; it's a walk with the Lord. Keep going!
A few chapters left—let's work together to finish them.
It's okay; God is waiting for you to open the Bible anytime.
It's never too late! Even one line today is a great start.
May the Holy Spirit urge your heart to resume this spiritual habit.
Busy days happen, but don't forget to make time for spiritual food.
This progress is just a pit stop; let's refresh and carry on.
Keep going! With steady effort, you will reach your goal.

zh: 這份進度還留在未來，我們可以預備心來領受。
即將到來的讀經旅程，願您帶著期待與神相遇。
en: This progress stays in the future; let's prepare our hearts to receive it.
As the reading journey approaches, may you meet God with expectation.
